reference_status: automatic stored corpus labels; agreement, not human-validated accuracy

statistics.repetition_policy: average two outcomes within item before cluster resampling
statistics.intervals: descriptive paired 95% percentile intervals, without multiplicity adjustment; no significance declarations
statistics.grouping_caveat: fixed inference batches for primary intervals; observed author/source groups for sensitivity, not known poem groups

metric_notes.feature_components: Feature scores compare sets irrespective of type; joint also requires correct stress. Invalid inference contributes every reference feature as FN.
metric_notes.empty_sets: Valid empty/empty per-item F1=1; invalid output F1=0. Undefined aggregate micro F1 is null.
metric_notes.core_joint: Remove COPY and MOSAIC from both sets before exact joint comparison; no other normalization.
metric_notes.stability: Both repetitions must be valid and have identical type/set; invalid-invalid is never counted stable. E uses a different frozen example draw in each repetition, so E stability combines demonstration-selection and decoding variability.
metric_notes.cost: All committed attempts included. Condition R/V/W incremental costs exclude the reused S call; standalone-condition totals add its full recorded cost. Grand totals count physical attempts once. Latencies are per batch, not per-pair measured latency. Cached/reasoning token fields are separate counters, not added to their enclosing totals. No inferred dollars.

standalone_pipeline_latency.note: Sum of recorded inference-attempt durations across stages, excluding queue/wait time; not experiment wall-clock duration
